feature: Click, let go, click again draws a line
summary: With the Line or Arrow tool, a click starts a line that follows the pointer, and a second click puts it down. Dragging still draws in one go. Before this, a click made nothing at all.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/click-click-draws-a-line-walk.json.

try.do: Before: with the Line tool, click, let go and move the pointer. Nothing followed it and the second click made nothing.
Now: press L, click once on the picture, let go and move the pointer. The line follows it.
Click again to end the line. Press Command-Z once: the whole line goes in one step.
Click to start another line, hold Shift and move. It holds to 0, 45 or 90 degrees; click to place it.
Start a line and press Escape, or click its start point again, or pick another tool. Nothing is made.
Press A and do the same with an arrow. The caption field opens after the second click, not the first.
Press I and measure by clicks (start, end, then a click for the number), or by dragging and then a click. Both still work.

evaluate: Does a click-started line feel as quick as the drag, with nothing in the way?
Is clicking back on the start point the right way to call a line off, or would you rather it made nothing only with Escape?
Should Rectangle, Ellipse and Highlight also start by a click and end by a second click, or is drag-only right for boxes?
After a click closes an arrow's caption field, Select comes back as before instead of starting a new arrow. Is that what you expect?
rough: No mock covers how a line is drawn; this follows your words from 2026-10-04.

Rectangle, Ellipse and Highlight still draw only by dragging, and a click with them still makes nothing. A box needs both its corners, so a lone click could only leave a box stuck to the pointer by accident.
Measure already took clicks: start, end, then a third click to place the number (your call on 2026-09-02, next-measure.md section 10). It is unchanged, so measuring by clicks takes three, not two.
A drawing drag shows no size or angle pill, only the yellow snap guide. The click-started line shows the same guide and no pill either.
